title: Debug Logs

request.justification: Need to investigate payment processing error in production logs

expected.explanation: Developer role permits read-only access to prod S3 with internal classification

teachingPoint: Prod read access is not the same as prod write — scoped log access for debugging is appropriate

title: Broad Compute

request.justification: Need to spin up instances in production for performance testing

expected.explanation: No matching allow in Role Matrix for role "Developer", action "ec2:RunInstances", resource type "ec2", environment "prod"

teachingPoint: Provisioning in production is not in the Developer role — separation of duties and environment guardrails prevent this

title: Snapshot Panic

request.justification: Want to create a snapshot of the production database to analyze data offline

expected.explanation: No matching allow in Role Matrix for role "Data Analyst", action "rds:CreateDBSnapshot", resource type "rds", environment "prod"

teachingPoint: Creating database snapshots is a write-like operation — Data Analysts have read-only access, not operational control

title: Lambda Test in Staging

request.justification: Testing updated API handler function before production deployment

expected.explanation: Developer role permits lambda:InvokeFunction and lambda:GetFunction in staging with confidential classification

teachingPoint: Staging is the right place to test — developers have full Lambda access in non-prod environments

title: Intern in Staging

request.justification: Want to see staging infrastructure for my onboarding report

expected.explanation: Intern role only permits ec2:DescribeInstances in dev, not staging

teachingPoint: Interns are restricted to dev only — staging has real-ish data and is off limits

title: Security Checks Staging Trails

request.justification: Reviewing staging CloudTrail for suspicious deployment patterns

expected.explanation: Security Engineer role permits CloudTrail read actions in all environments

teachingPoint: Security Engineers monitor all environments — staging can reveal attack patterns before they hit prod

title: Analyst Queries Staging

request.justification: Testing new query against staging data before running on prod

expected.explanation: Data Analyst role permits Athena query actions in staging with confidential classification

teachingPoint: Testing queries in staging first is good practice — and the role matrix supports it

title: Developer Cleans Staging

request.justification: Cleaning up old test export files from staging bucket

expected.explanation: Developer role permits s3:DeleteObject in staging with confidential classification

teachingPoint: Developers can manage their team's staging data including deletes — staging is their sandbox

title: Auditor Reads Prod Configs

request.justification: Reviewing compliance report artifacts for regulatory filing

expected.explanation: Auditor role permits S3 read in prod with restricted classification

teachingPoint: Auditors have the broadest read access — they need to see everything for compliance verification

title: Developer Checks Staging DB

request.justification: Checking database instance status before running migration

expected.explanation: Developer role permits rds:DescribeDBInstances in staging with confidential classification

teachingPoint: Describe actions are low-risk metadata reads — developers need them for operational awareness
